Title: The recommendation and policy to enable encryption of storage account have been removed

Body.Content: Azure Storage is encrypted by default now and cannot be un-encrypted. Therefore, the Enable encryption of storage account recommendation and its corresponding policy, (Preview): Audit missing blob encryption for storage accounts, have been removed. For more information, see Azure Storage encryption for data at rest.
